Name: Lara Acosta
Content:
We cancelled our sales kickoff and mailed every rep a spreadsheet instead.

Attendance was 100%.

The spreadsheet had one tab: every deal they lost in Q2, with the sentence the buyer used when they said no. 38 rows. 31 of them contained the word "later".

Nobody asked for a keynote. Three reps asked for the buyer's phone number.

Name: Lara Acosta
Content:
Our onboarding doc is 41 pages.

New hires read page 1 and then ask Priya.

So we replaced pages 2 to 41 with a photo of Priya's desk and the words "ask Priya". Time to first merged PR went from 9 days to 4.

Priya has requested a raise. This is the correct outcome.
